# Scenario: domain inbound + cert-issue-type mock issues local self-signed PEMs
# under infra/mockcerts/<domain>/ (no ACME / dig) and wires nginx HTTPS.

cd git-repo
exec git init -b main
exec git config user.email 'test@apinfra.local'
exec git config user.name 'Test Agent'
exec git add .
exec git commit -m 'feat: domain mock cert fixture'
cd ..

cp .apinfra.template .apinfra
exec sh -c 'echo "repo=file://'$WORK'/git-repo" >> .apinfra'

exec apinfra
stderr 'cert issued name=e2e-mock.apinfra.test mode=mock'
stderr 'done duration='

exists $HOME/infra/mockcerts/e2e-mock.apinfra.test/fullchain.pem
exists $HOME/infra/mockcerts/e2e-mock.apinfra.test/privkey.pem
! exists $HOME/infra/certbot/conf/live/e2e-mock.apinfra.test/fullchain.pem

exists $HOME/infra/nginx/conf/dev_e2e-web.conf
grep 'server_name e2e-mock\.apinfra\.test' $HOME/infra/nginx/conf/dev_e2e-web.conf
grep 'listen 443 ssl' $HOME/infra/nginx/conf/dev_e2e-web.conf
grep '/etc/nginx/mockcerts/e2e-mock\.apinfra\.test/fullchain\.pem' $HOME/infra/nginx/conf/dev_e2e-web.conf

docker-assert-running apinfra_e2e-web-web-1

-- .apinfra.template --
namespace=dev
repoBranch=main

-- git-repo/dev/settings.yml --
version: "1.0"
projects:
  - name: e2e-web
    enabled: true
    proxy:
      inbound:
        domain-name: e2e-mock.apinfra.test
      target:
        service-name: web
        port: 80
    config:
      cert-issue-type: mock

-- git-repo/dev/e2e-web/docker-compose.yml --
services:
  web:
    image: hashicorp/http-echo:latest
    command: ["-listen=:80", "-text=OK"]

-- .env --
